important_limits: All five deployable Rust stages were actually executed at every requested size; no Rust value is inferred.
Native runtimes above calibration sizes are conditional linear extrapolations, not completed native sweeps.

The native prepared Ridge wrapper and sklearn calibrations use the same original 55-feature matrices and sampled alpha/intercept/cost sequence as Rust, but retain native prediction > 0 scoring and native backend behavior.

The full native CLI reference repeats the earlier 13-feature raw-data workflow; it is a separately labeled throughput normalization, not a same-input end-to-end comparison with the 55-feature Rust workload.
Terasweep retains its different backtest economics and solver_eps failure convention. Sample counts include cached failures and repeated draws.
The 1b sweep is sampled with replacement; it does not contain 1b distinct configurations.
Shared VM; one timed process per cell; percent-level ordering differences are not statistically established.
Timing includes each complete Rust process from fresh computational caches, with normal OS file caching.
